Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Please note our cost context: CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
move.body:
Dear Birgit Mayrhofer,

Thank you for your quotation and for setting out the input cost increases behind it. Those pressures are real, and our opening is grounded in our analysis of this part.

Our should-cost estimate for this part is EUR 403.21 per unit (cost:350020).

We suggest the recommended option: it keeps your quoted payment terms and gives you a longer agreement at the volume you quoted. The alternative offers a higher unit price in return for longer payment terms. Our standard payment term is 60 days net: paying earlier ties up our working capital, so an option with faster payment carries a lower price. If quick payment matters to you, Option A pays in 30 days.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 411.91 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement, 4,580 pcs per year.
Option B: EUR 417.44 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement, 4,580 pcs per year.

Could you share a cost breakdown for this part covering material, conversion and overhead?

We look forward to your view and to agreeing terms that support reliable supply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your message.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €432.29 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.
For your information:
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
Our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length.
Company policy restricts price reductions on standard terms, but we value the stability of a longer commitment.
By adopting the 24-month contract term from your Option A, we are able to offer a revised price of EUR 429.36 per unit.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €429.36 per unit.
Material accounts for about 42 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
Should you require further information, please let us know.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
move.body:
Dear Birgit Mayrhofer,

Thank you for checking our should-cost analysis and revising your offer for a longer commitment. We understand that your policy limits price reductions on standard terms and that you cannot share further cost detail.

We have moved our proposal toward your revised offer, which is a meaningful concession for us, and ask you to move on price in return. The recommended option retains the agreement length you proposed; if longer planning certainty matters more, the alternative extends our commitment in exchange for a lower price.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 421.20 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement, 4,580 pcs per year.
Option B: EUR 416.99 per unit, payment 90 days net, 36-month agreement, 4,580 pcs per year.

Which volume or contract length would let you improve the price further?

We look forward to agreeing terms that support reliable supply for both companies.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
move.body:
Dear Birgit Mayrhofer,

Thank you for revising your quotation and explaining that a longer agreement alone does not reduce the price under your policy. We understand why a binding higher volume would help you, but the price movement remains too small.

We are holding our last offer because the revised price is still not acceptable for a stable renewal. The recommended option retains your proposed payment terms; the longer-agreement alternative gives you more planning certainty without asking us to commit to volume we cannot substantiate. We keep our offer as it stands.

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 421.20 per unit, payment 90 days net, 24-month agreement, 4,580 pcs per year.
Option B: EUR 416.99 per unit, payment 90 days net, 36-month agreement, 4,580 pcs per year.

We hope you can reconsider the price so we can continue our longstanding relationship on reliable terms.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
